title: Member Disclosure — Payoff Quotes and Paying Off a Farm Real Estate Loans Mortgage
content:
**What a payoff quote states.** A payoff quote on a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage, for the payoff date the member names, states:

1. unpaid fees;
2. unpaid billed interest;
3. interest from the day after the last due date through the payoff date (at the default rate where default interest applies);
4. the prepayment fee under the prepayment terms; and
5. the principal balance.

**How long a quote is good.** It is good through the product's payoff quote validity in calendar days after the quote date, the quote date being day 0.

**When the loan is paid off.** The loan is paid off on the effective date of the payment that brings everything owed to zero. Every parcel is then released with the release reason payoff, and the recorded release of mortgage is delivered within the product's release processing business days. Any overpayment is refunded.

## Quote illustration (hypothetical figures)

A member asks for a payoff on 31 March 2026; the last installment fell due on 1 March 2026. Principal USD 365000.00 at 7.000 percent, USD 50.00 of unpaid fees, no unpaid billed interest, a product with no prepayment fee in this loan year:

| Line | Amount (USD) |
|---|---|
| Unpaid fees | 50.00 |
| Unpaid billed interest | 0.00 |
| Interest 2 March through 31 March 2026 (30 days at USD 70.00 per day) | 2100.00 |
| Prepayment fee | 0.00 |
| Principal balance | 365000.00 |
| Total | 367150.00 |

**Validity (hypothetical dates).** A quote dated 2 March 2026 is day 0; with 15 days of validity it is good through 17 March 2026.
